description: Idempotency registry: has key K already been done? Claim it, complete it, read the stored result — Shared memory for side-effecting operations across agents and retries. begin(key) answers proceed (you hold a short claim), wait (another owner is mid-flight), already_completed (returns the stored result pointer), or fingerprint_mismatch (same key, different operation). complete(key) records the result pointer; abandon(key) lets someone retry. The claim expires, so a crashed worker does not block

claimSeconds.description: How long a begin claim lasts; default 300.

fingerprint.description: Hash of the operation's identity fields; a later begin with a different fingerprint is refused.

owner.description: Worker id; required for begin, complete and abandon.

requestId.description: Caller-chosen id for this mutation. A retry with the same id and same input returns the stored response (24 h) instead of applying twice; the same id with different input is rejected. Send one on every mutation you may retry: without it a retry is applied again (fleet-memory record appends a duplicate; a repeated spend-ledger commit or release answers NO_HOLD because the first call already took effect).

result.description: complete: where the outcome lives (do not store payloads here).

retentionHours.description: How long a completed key is remembered; default 24.

tenantId.description: Required for API-key callers (namespaced as key:<tenantId>; keep it unguessable). Ignored when a wallet paid: the payer address is the tenant.

name: idempotency-registry
